اخضوضرا (form XII)
# اِخْضَوْضَرَا (iḵḍawḍarā) /ix.dˤaw.dˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْضَوْضَرَ (iḵḍawḍara)
# اِخْضَوْضِرَا (iḵḍawḍirā) /ix.dˤaw.dˤi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْضَوْضَرَ (iḵḍawḍara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
